source.body:
## Canonical full-use, 8-role, all-112-requirements delivery clock

**Owner request (23 Nov 2026):** Every response to **"continue the recommended sequence"**, **"check the recommended sequence"** or **"live position"** must start with the same current GitHub-backed hour-by-hour roadmap, then state and execute or recommend the exact next unblocked task. This issue is the dashboard index. The complete ledger is immutable until a documented evidence-backed revision, not an unattended background monitor.

### Open the live planning records

- [**Dashboard, all 60 packages and acceptance exits**](https://github.com/threeswordz/cinder-grind/blob/docs-erp-full-use-1900h-hourly-ledger-20261123/docs/ERP-FULL-USE-LIVE-CLOCK.md)
- [**H0001–H1900, one forecast-hour row each (CSV)**](https://github.com/threeswordz/cinder-grind/blob/docs-erp-full-use-1900h-hourly-ledger-20261123/docs/ERP-FULL-USE-HOURLY-1900.csv)
- [**Machine-readable ledger: packages/status/verified hours**](https://github.com/threeswordz/cinder-grind/blob/docs-erp-full-use-1900h-hourly-ledger-20261123/docs/ERP-FULL-USE-WORKPACKAGES.json)

**Anchored planning snapshot:** 2026-11-23 16:17:49 SGT, `main` at `3a441b1fa389a9a274e6ca82413740a3ffa2f51b`. The branch changes only documentation and is **NOT merged**; it does not trigger any GitHub Actions or full CI. No source, main, Mac, retained HR/Finance data, Production or role grants touched.

| Live counter (baseline only; refresh on each request) | Initial checkpoint |
|---|---|
| Official prototype outcomes | **4/8** complete (milestones 1,2,3,5) |
| Official production readiness gates | **3/10** complete (GL-01–03) |
| Current forecast work cursor | **H0001–H0020, M4-01: reconcile 112 real requirements; M4 total H0001–H0170** |
| Forecast remaining budget at anchor | **1,900 productive engineering hours** |
| Verified work hours retired *after this baseline* | **0 hours**, intentionally, because existing tested code/PRs were reflected in the 1,900-hour net forecast, not fresh earned credit |
| Actual measured worker hours | **UNKNOWN** until timesheets/work logs exist; never invent |
| Baseline (one 35 productive-hour/week workstream) | **~54.3 work weeks, ~8 December 2027**, assumes no external delays |
| Parallel 65 productive-hour/week scenario | **~29.2 work weeks, ~15 June 2027**, requires actual staffing |
| Forecast sensitivity | **1,100–3,300h** remaining; HR/Accounting legal/policy, real roles and #245 scope high uncertainty |

### Required universal dashboard format

**Every check must display:** (1) SGT now, latest main/PR/run; (2) official M?/8 and GL?/10, do not call them percentage of project effort; (3) current hour range Hxxxx–Hyyyy and work-package ID, status, acceptance dependency; (4) `verified planned-hours retired / revised remaining hours` and **% of forward work budget**, with a horizontal bar; (5) updated ETAs at 35h/week and 65h/week **recalculated from today's SGT date**, plus risk; (6) exact evidence newly accepted, no false credit for speculative time or partial tests; (7) next authorized action, Owner-only gates and no repeated full CI. If nothing changed, state **"No newly earned work-hours; estimate unchanged"** instead of silently subtracting elapsed time.

**Planning cursor, not wall-clock:** CSV's H0001–H1900 are one-hour units in a forecast, not fixed appointments; progress uses exit-verified acceptance of numbered work packages, not commit counts, CI runtime or waiting hours. The official milestone count changes only at its real Owner/GitHub exit gates. An approved scope increase changes the baseline in an explicitly recorded revision; do not hide it by manipulating a percentage.

### Stage totals (baseline only)

| Order | Work category | Hour numbers | Increment |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| 1 | Prototype Milestone 4 → 5/8 | H0001–H0170 | 170h |
| 2 | Prototype Milestone 6 → 6/8 | H0171–H0290 | 120h |
| 3 | Prototype Milestone 7 → 7/8 | H0291–H0340 | 50h |
| 4 | Prototype Milestone 8 → 8/8 | H0341–H0405 | 65h |
| 5 | GL-05 full HR, OT, leave, payroll | H0406–H0705 | 300h |
| 6 | GL-06 full Accounting, tax, banking, GL | H0706–H1185 | 480h |
| 7 | #245 plus budget/exception scope | H1186–H1315 | 130h |
| 8 | GL-04 complete eight-role operational acceptance | H1316–H1435 | 120h |
| 9 | GL-07 release security | H1436–H1530 | 95h |
| 10 | GL-08 actual Production hosting/recovery | H1531–H1640 | 110h |
| 11 | GL-09 real data/roles/onboarding | H1641–H1750 | 110h |
| 12 | GL-10 comprehensive eight-role UAT, cutover and acceptance | H1751–H1900 | 150h |

*Not a promise of chronological independence: HR, GL, governance, infrastructure and data preparation may overlap where authorized, but the cumulative hour forecast uses a serial 35-hour/week baseline. No full-completion claim while any of 112 requirements, all eight-role workflows, Accounting/HR or actual Production remains unresolved.*

**Owners and protection:** #305 milestone board, #278 GL board, #304 requirement reconciliations and #384 no-waste-full-CI rule are controlling. No Ready, protected-main merge or mandatory full CI without its special authorization; no Production without separate explicit Owner authority. The ledger is planning-only, not approval for accounting/payroll policies, host credentials, data migration or cutover.

### Update discipline

On every substantive new acceptance, append dated exact-SHA/PR/CI/role proof to this issue and update the package/forecast state on a docs-only planning branch (or its eventual approved merged successor). Deduct only verified *remaining-hours estimate* of completed packages; actual work hours stay separate. If a forecast changes, add a signed delta and explain why. Checking does not trigger CI. This provides persistent evidence across new chats rather than relying solely on conversation memory.
